meta.title: Implement Salsa-based incremental compilation
meta.body_summary: Add Salsa-based incremental compilation infrastructure, introducing a tracked parse_file query for automatic caching to enable fast recompilation and future IDE support.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code added Salsa incremental parsing infrastructure with tests; self-merged by maintainer without external review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 145 changed lines, this is a small change by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround performance PR and is consistent with the successful self-merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No review text available; PR was self-merged by the maintainer.
review_details.performance_claim: Incremental compilation using Salsa for fast recompilation and caching.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Integration of Salsa incremental computation framework into a Rust compiler pipeline; Claude Code successfully added tracked functions, database setup, and tests demonstrating caching behavior.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer (also PR author) reviewed the code before merging; no formal review recorded.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Tests verify incremental caching (same result on unchanged input) but no before/after timing data or benchmark.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression reported; PR merged after tests passed.

core_change_summary.description: Added Salsa database (`RueDatabase`) and a `parse_file` tracked function that caches parsing results; updated lib.rs with Salsa setup, included tests to verify caching behavior, and modified parser's `ParseError` to derive `PartialEq` for Salsa compatibility. Also added an example file demonstrating usage.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Parser change is a one-line derive addition.
change_trajectory: Single commit adds Salsa infrastructure, tests, and example.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with Salsa incremental compilation implementation and tests.
Force-pushed twice, presumably to clean up commit.
Maintainer self-merged after ~20 minutes with no external review.
